sentences.text: Present: Mr. Jeevan Kumar, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Deputy Advocate General for the respondent-State.
Notice.
Mr. Ajit Sharma, Learned Deputy Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the sole respondent.
Let status report be filed in two weeks.
List the matter on 28th May, 2024.

2. The bail petitioner [Gagandeep] has come up before this Court, under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking pre-arrest bail, originating from FIR No.55 of 2024, dated 25.03.2024,
registered at Police Station, Damtal, District Kangra, [H.P.], under Sections 406, 408, 420, 120-B of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The case set up by Mr. Jeevan Kumar, Learned Counsel, on behalf of the bail petitioner [Gagandeep], is that the petitioner is permanent resident of the address as mentioned in the memo of parties.
It is further averred that the bail-petitioner [Gagandeep] is engaged as watchman by the Swastik Food Products Damtal (complainant) having no role in the matter.

It is further averred that the alleged false weighing slips resulting in financial loss were issued by two other .
persons i.e. Mr. Kunal Sharma, (main accused), who is contractor and one Sh. Rahul who was the Supervisor in the aforesaid Swasthik Food Products Limited.
It is further averred that the entire illegal activity, were done by Mr. Kunal Sharma in connivance with each other 4. to and was prepared false weighing slips.

It is further averred in the bail application that at the instance of Rahul who was Supervisor, the bail-petitioner [Gagandeep) asked him to accept some monetary transaction in his account and,
therefore, though the bail petitioner has no connection with the alleged offence has been falsely implicated or is being roped in the instant case.
5. It is stated that the bail petitioner has been falsely implicated and there is no connection of the bail petitioner with the alleged offences.

However, the bail petitioner has given the undertakings that the bail petitioner shall join the investigation as and when called for and the bail petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence or the witnesses and shall not cause any inducement, threat or promise to any person or persons acquainted with the facts of the case in any manner.
